item.title: Before Kids Learn to Think, They’re Learning to Prompt
item.description: A.I. expert Sheldon Fernandez analyzes how generative tools are shaping young, formative minds, arguing that the real risk is not exposure to new technology, but the premature outsourcing of thinking itself. Fernandez contends that generative A.I. must be positioned as a catalyst for reasoning rather than a substitute for it.
